## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Cohere integration change
- [ ] Cloudflare infrastructure change

## Blueprint Alignment

- [ ] This change follows the blueprint (blueprint.md)
- [ ] This change requires a ChangeControl record (deviation from blueprint)
- [ ] This change resolves an audit item (blueprint_audit.md)

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests pass (`pnpm test:unit`)
- [ ] Security tests pass (`pnpm test:security`)
- [ ] Type check passes (`tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] No secrets in code (security scan passes)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published
